# Fred Wright & Gilbert Blythe

- [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) — Comrade of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — canvassing partners · since v2  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) continue canvassing neighbors for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), encountering an overly neat woman, odd locals, and an unhelpful household. Capitalizing on the birth of Lorenzo White's new son, [Anne](../character/anne.md) secures a generous five-dollar donation after admiring the newborn. Later that night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) attempts to canvass Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), but he refuses to contribute any money.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) on his porch about [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Davy's antics, and the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) discovers that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) has accidentally painted the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair over the blunder, but the town's sympathy ultimately turns in their favor against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who talks about church preparations, and upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn from a letter that the twins will stay with them until fall. [Anne](../character/anne.md) recalls a humorous interaction with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his antics and misinterpretations of the catechism. Later, at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the group is distressed to hear that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and an unsuccessful committee sent to reason with him leaves them dismayed.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a busy month helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her upcoming wedding and discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) stumbles upon [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) professing their love for each other in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. The next evening, [Diana](../character/diana.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reflect on love and her own imagined future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) attend a farewell party thrown by the A.V.I.S., where they receive gifts before [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) to spite [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). The next evening, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and takes her on a walk through the woods to find a wild apple tree, restoring her spirits ahead of her departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends her summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) enjoying visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and the Irvings, though she is secretly bothered by Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) deals with growing up and losing his imaginative childhood visions at the shore. Later at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) gently questions [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her disrupted relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside on a June evening. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) complains about his schoolwork and the local funerals, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers to help him with his arithmetic. The conversation turns to local gossip, including Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and the town's reaction to [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejecting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling melancholic about Gilbert's absence and the changes that growing up brings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana.md) prepare for her wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their lifelong friendship as [Diana](../character/diana.md) nervously prepares to walk down the aisle. After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) escorts [Anne](../character/anne.md) home and they take a moonlight walk through Lovers' Lane. During their walk, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her plans to substitute as a teacher in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and feels a bittersweet nostalgia for how much [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) has changed.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling a sense of disappointment and loneliness following her rejection of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She learns local gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), hears news of friends' engagements and marriages, visits Diana's new baby, and attends Phil's wedding.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) awakens on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her past in her little room. Friends and family gather as preparations finish and [Anne](../character/anne.md) marries [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the sunshine of the old orchard. After a joyous celebration, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) depart for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary as their loved ones bid them farewell.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES
